_comment: A worked example of the candidate file, matching the example ledger. Every value here is an unverified claim by whoever wrote it, which is exactly what a candidate file holds. What was observed lives in tiers/ and only that can route.

api-strong-a.note: the reference for both families in the example ledger

api-cheap-a.note: wire is 'responses' because this endpoint refuses function tools with a reasoning setting on chat completions; the score belongs to the wire it was measured over

self-hosted-a.note: an hourly bill, so its cost per request depends on this family's realised throughput and cannot be borrowed from another family's

_families_note: config_format 2: a family is an object, not a bare reference string, because the floor is declared per family (SCOPE sections 2, 5, 12) beside the reference it falls back to. The two families here carry DIFFERENT floors on purpose -- agentic-coding tolerates more failure than the retail tool-use family does -- so a regression that collapsed them back to one shared number would show up as a wrong floor on one of the two rather than passing silently.
_label_source_note: C4 (amendment 4): label_source is oracle.kind's vocabulary read from schema.json at load time, plus 'none'. The two families use DIFFERENT values on purpose, and neither is the obvious guess for its domain -- agentic-coding's CI-graded tasks settle fast (max_label_latency_s 3600s) and independently of any candidate, so it declares an exploration_rate; the retail family's label comes from an LLM judge (model_judge, the weakest and slowest of the seven, so max_label_latency_s is 259200s) that may itself be one of this family's candidates, so label_independent_of_candidate is false and exploration_rate is absent -- present, load_config would refuse it, naming both the rate and the reason.
_staleness_limit_note: C3 (amendment 5): staleness_limit_days is required on every family, and null is legitimate only when the family cannot explore. agentic-coding explores, so it declares a limit (21 days) bounding how stale a bound explore.clears_floor may draw into past the ratchet; null there would be refused alongside exploration_rate, naming both. tool-agent-user-retail does not explore (label_independent_of_candidate is false), so null here is the honest declaration of no stated limit rather than a value nothing needed.
_throughput_note: No throughput override here on purpose. Each record carries its own per-family latency and the concurrency it was measured at, so the figure lives in one place. Override only when you measured throughput under load -- an assumed concurrency is what made an earlier figure in this project wrong.
_gateway_pin: The API candidates are pinned to gateway image tag main-7129eb0-amd64, built from commit 7129eb0 and immutable in the registry. A gateway decides the wire, the parameters it forwards, the prices it charges against and what it reports as success, so a record taken against one version does not describe another. `substrate_matches()` compares this against each record's measurement_target.gateway_version, and reports when it cannot compare at all rather than passing in silence.
